name: GiftPillars - Numbered Bordered Grid
description: The gift grid on cream with 01 / 02 / 03 in bordered cells sharing single-pixel rules, replacing the three icon badges. The numerals are NOT passed in — giftOrdinal derives them from each card's position in the band, so this frame proves the derivation rather than a list someone typed. That is the same rule that makes a duplicated grouped gift band restart at 01 instead of continuing at 04.
